description: Fig. 3 is a composite 4-column x 3-row TEM/SAED plate of twelve panels (a-l) characterising precipitates in three conditions of a Fe-20Mn-9Al-1.5C-2Ni-3Cr low-density steel: S1000 (a-d), S1050 (e-h) and MHT (i-l). Columns 1-2 are the kappa-carbide pair: (a), (e), (i) are dark-field TEM images labelled "kappa-carbide" in which white arrows mark fine bright particles, each with a 50 nm scale bar; (b), (f), (j) are the matching SAED patterns of austenite, indexed with yellow and red rhombi (100, 200, 01-1-, 111-) and lettered with the zone axis [011]gamma // [011]kappa, the faint superlattice reflections being enclosed by red dotted lines. Columns 3-4 cover the other phases: (c) is a bright-field TEM image of a grain-boundary area in S1000 (500 nm bar) with an elongated dark stripe-like precipitate circled in red, and (d) is its SAED pattern indexed 220 and 02-1- with orange dotted lines and the zone axis [11-2-]Cr7C3; (g) (200 nm bar) with (h) show a dark B2 particle in S1050 indexed 1-01-, 011- and [1-11]B2; (k) (500 nm bar) with (l) show the analogous B2 particle in MHT indexed 2-11-, 110 and [1-13]B2. Read together, the figure demonstrates nanometre kappa-carbide co-gridded with austenite in all three steels, grain-boundary Cr7C3 only in S1000 and B2 in S1050 and MHT.
measured_quantities: kappa-carbide particle size (nm); reported as 3-10 nm in the citing text
B2 particle size (nm); reported as 20-160 nm in the citing text
diffraction spot indices and zone axes (Miller indices)

observations.observation: The figure is a 4-column x 3-row composite of twelve TEM/SAED panels lettered (a) to (l), with three dark-field micrographs labelled 'kappa-carbide' in the first column, three austenite SAED patterns in the second, three bright-field micrographs in the third and three SAED patterns of secondary phases in the fourth.
Panels (a), (e) and (i) each carry the printed text 'kappa-carbide', white arrows pointing at fine bright particles, and a 50 nm scale bar.

Panels (b), (f) and (j) all print the identical zone-axis annotation '[011]gamma // [011]kappa' and show diffraction spots indexed 100, 200, 01-1- and 111- enclosed in yellow and red rhombi, with faint additional spots enclosed by red dotted lines.
Panel (d) is indexed with the reflections 220 and 02-1- inside an orange rhombus and carries the zone-axis label '[11-2-]Cr7C3'.
Panel (h) prints reflections 1-01- and 011- and the zone-axis label '[1-11]B2', while panel (l) prints reflections 2-11- and 110 and the zone-axis label '[1-13]B2'.

Red circles highlight the specific precipitates examined by diffraction: an elongated dark stripe-like particle at a grain-boundary junction in (c), a single dark particle in (g), and a small dark particle decorating an elongated bright band in (k).
The caption states that the plate shows TEM and SAED micrographs of precipitates in S1000 (a-d), S1050 (e-h) and MHT (i-l).

The citing text reports that the dark-field TEM images corresponding to the additional diffraction spots show kappa-carbide particles with sizes ranging from 3 to 10 nm, marked by white arrows in the dark-field panels.

The citing text states that the SAED patterns of austenite contain additional faint superlattice diffraction spots (marked by red dotted lines), indicating kappa-carbide co-gridded with austenite, with the orientation relationship [011]gamma // [011]kappa.

The citing text identifies the elongated stripe-like precipitates on the austenite grain boundaries of S1000 as Cr7C3 (panels c and d), and states that Cr7C3 dissolves at the grain boundary when the temperature increases to 1050 C.
The citing text reports a small amount of B2 phase, 20 to 160 nm in size, in the austenite of S1050 (panels g and h), also present in MHT (panels k and l) but slightly smaller than in S1050.

No numeric particle-size values (e.g. 3-10 nm or 20-160 nm) are printed inside any panel; only scale bars (50 nm, 200 nm, 500 nm), Miller indices, zone-axis labels and the text 'kappa-carbide' are printed.
